1.w: A well-written song by Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing continually about the Lord ’s faithful deeds; to future generations I will proclaim your faithfulness.

2.w: For I say, “Loyal love is permanently established; in the skies you set up your faithfulness.”

3.w: The Lord said, “I have made a covenant with my chosen one; I have made a promise on oath to David, my servant:

4.w: ‘I will give you an eternal dynasty and establish your throne throughout future generations.’” (Selah)

5.w: O Lord , the heavens praise your amazing deeds, as well as your faithfulness in the angelic assembly.

6.w: For who in the skies can compare to the Lord ? Who is like the Lord among the heavenly beings,

7.w: a God who is honored in the great angelic assembly, and more awesome than all who surround him?

8.w: O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies! Who is strong like you, O Lord ? Your faithfulness surrounds you.

9.w: You rule over the proud sea. When its waves surge, you calm them.

10.w: You crushed the Proud One and killed it; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.

11.w: The heavens belong to you, as does the earth. You made the world and all it contains.

12.w: You created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

13.w: Your arm is powerful, your hand strong, your right hand victorious.

14.w: Equity and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loyal love and faithfulness characterize your rule.

15.w: How blessed are the people who worship you! O Lord , they experience your favor.

16.w: They rejoice in your name all day long, and are vindicated by your justice.

17.w: For you give them splendor and strength. By your favor we are victorious.

18.w: For our shield belongs to the Lord , our king to the Holy One of Israel.

19.w: Then you spoke through a vision to your faithful followers and said: “I have placed a young hero over a warrior; I have raised up a young man from the people.

20.w: I have discovered David, my servant. With my holy oil I have anointed him as king.

21.w: My hand will support him, and my arm will strengthen him.

22.w: No enemy will be able to exact tribute from him; a violent oppressor will not be able to humiliate him.

23.w: I will crush his enemies before him; I will strike down those who hate him.

24.w: He will experience my faithfulness and loyal love, and by my name he will win victories.

25.w: I will place his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.

26.w: He will call out to me, ‘You are my father, my God, and the protector who delivers me.’

27.w: I will appoint him to be my firstborn son, the most exalted of the earth’s kings.

28.w: I will always extend my loyal love to him, and my covenant with him is secure.

29.w: I will give him an eternal dynasty and make his throne as enduring as the skies above.

30.w: If his sons reject my law and disobey my regulations,

31.w: if they break my rules and do not keep my commandments,

32.w: I will punish their rebellion by beating them with a club, their sin by inflicting them with bruises.

33.w: But I will not remove my loyal love from him nor be unfaithful to my promise.

34.w: I will not break my covenant or go back on what I promised.

35.w: Once and for all I have vowed by my own holiness, I will never deceive David.

36.w: His dynasty will last forever. His throne will endure before me, like the sun;

37.w: it will remain stable, like the moon. His throne will endure like the skies.” (Selah)

38.w: But you have spurned and rejected him; you are angry with your chosen king.

39.w: You have repudiated your covenant with your servant; you have thrown his crown to the ground.

40.w: You have broken down all his walls; you have made his strongholds a heap of ruins.

41.w: All who pass by have robbed him; he has become an object of disdain to his neighbors.

42.w: You have allowed his adversaries to be victorious and all his enemies to rejoice.

43.w: You turn back his sword from the adversary and have not sustained him in battle.

44.w: You have brought to an end his splendor and have knocked his throne to the ground.

45.w: You have cut short his youth and have covered him with shame. (Selah)

46.w: How long, O Lord , will this last? Will you remain hidden forever? Will your anger continue to burn like fire?

47.w: Take note of my brief lifespan. Why do you make all people so mortal?

48.w: No man can live on without experiencing death or deliver his life from the power of Sheol. (Selah)

49.w: Where are your earlier faithful deeds, O Lord, the ones performed in accordance with your reliable oath to David?

50.w: Take note, O Lord, of the way your servants are taunted and of how I must bear so many insults from people.

51.w: Your enemies, O Lord , hurl insults; they insult your chosen king as they dog his footsteps.

52.w: The Lord deserves praise forevermore! We agree! We agree!
